description.value:
Bodyguards to the powerful and paragons of martial discipline, Praetorian Specialists perfect both body and mind in equal measure. Their training goes beyond mere swordplay, cultivating a poise and self-control that serves them as well in a royal court as on a battlefield.

This inner discipline becomes a literal engine of war — a burning fighting spirit that sharpens their strikes and shields them from harm even as their body fails. A true Praetorian Specialist can be struck down again and again and still refuses to stop fighting until the very last breath.
